subject: Logic
title: Two-Track Analysis
description: A quick, practical guide to Two-Track Analysis.

hook.text: Your gut says invest. The spreadsheet says don't. Which one is right? Maybe both—they're answering different questions.

buildup.text: Two-track analysis runs intuition and analysis in parallel, then compares where they agree and diverge.

discovery.text: When both tracks agree, confidence rises. When they diverge, that's where the real thinking begins.

twist.text: Neither track is always right. Intuition misses data; analysis misses context and experience.

climax.text: Investigate the divergence. Your gut may have noticed something your spreadsheet can't model, or vice versa.

quiz.question: What makes two-track analysis valuable?
options: It always chooses the intuitive answer
It compares intuition and analysis to find blind spots
It eliminates the need for data
